author: KebabInATurban
body:
MAP NAME: Excalibur V 1.0
MAP CREATORS: ryanparker500, Epicraft321, danyman2202
ABOUT US: This is our first map and we were hoping to make a series of maps. Please give us tips and or ideas to help us with our map. We are having a TDM map coming soon. *NOTE We are first time map builders.
INFO ABOUT MAP: Player with start off with full leather except for iron leggings and the leather will be dyed to the team that they are on. Player will also receive a stone sword, 3 golden apples, 1 infinity bow, 16 cooked fish, 32 oak logs, 64 glass, and 1 arrow.
YML: Coming Soon
